description: Rename a category, change its description or image, move it under a different parent, or set its sortOrder. Takes the category id from get_categories, never a name. Only the fields you pass are changed. parentId can only MOVE the category under another one; making an existing subcategory top-level again is not supported here, and neither is it in the cabinet. A category synced from an integration (WooCommerce and the like) is read-only and will be refused — it has to be changed in that platform. This never touches which products are in the category; that lives on the product (update_product, categoryIds).

categoryId.description: Category id from get_categories — not a name

parentId.description: New parent id from get_categories. Cannot be the category itself or one of its own subcategories

sortOrder.description: Position among its siblings, lowest first

name: hub_update_category
title: Update category
